comments.body:
> This is because the resources you have at ETH for research simply blow any American university out of the water.

This is a very odd statement especially in relation to MIT. After experience in both top Swiss and US universities, I can unequivocally say that the level of resources — for experimental or computational projects — at MIT is unparalleled and far beyond what you will experience at European institutions. Even for top US universities, MIT is still quite far beyond essentially all of them in resources.
comments.author: WorldML
